title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 7)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 7), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: A continuation of the discussion refuting the attribution of physical limits or boundaries to God.
